page.layout: Right printed page only (p. 151). Full-width running text at top. Below it two parallel columns: Greek on the left, Latin on the right. Marginal note "POLYB." at the right margin beside the first Latin line. Strips at the left scan edge belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: vel aquis Stygiis restinguendae! Sed ARMA-tertia pars facta nostri sermonis, & inclusseram definitionis apertis verbis: MVLTITVDO IN ARMIS. Frustrà enim Dilectus &Ordo, nisi & hæc adsint, ac prompto iam pugnare militi dent quo pugnet. Arma igitur duplicia: ad petendum, ad tegendum. Illa Tela proprie, & hæc Arma. Sed Polybius in exsequendo discrimen hoc non seruat: seiungit ipse & describit secundum Genera militum, quæ dixi. Dat primo Velitibus arma sua, tum reliquis: & utraque illa mixtim pandit. Videamus, lege.

Καὶ τοῖς μὲν νεωτάτοις παρήγγειλαν μάχαιραν φορεῖν, καὶ γέσφους καὶ παρμίλω. ἡ δὲ πάρμη καὶ διάμιν ἔχει τὴν κατασκευὴν, καὶ μέγεθ᾽ ἀρκοῦ καὶ ὡς ἀσφάλειαν. περιφερὴς γὰρ οὖσα τὸ σχῆμα, τετράπεδον ἔχει τὸ διάμετρον. ἀσσεπικοσμεῖσαι δὲ καὶ λιτῷ περιεφαλαίῳ, ποτὲ λυκείων, ἢ π τῶν ζιούτων ἐπιτίθεται, σὲπης ἅμα καὶ σημείου χάριν, ἵνα τοῖς κατὰ μέρῳ ἡγεμόσι ἀσφαλιστέρους ἐρρωμένως καὶ μὴ διάδηλοι γίνωνται. τὸ δὲ τῶν γρόσφων βέλος ἔχει τὸ μὲν μήκει τὸ ξύλον, ὡς ἐπίταν δίπηχυ, τὸ δὲ πάχει δακτυλιαῖον· τὸ ὃ κέντρον, ἀπίθαμιαῖον,

Et iunioribus quidem man-POLYB. dabant gladium ferre, & hastas, & parmam. Parma autem & firmitate habet à structurâ, & magnitudinem qua sit tegendo. Cùm enim formâ rotundâ sit, tripedalem habet dimensionem. Adornatur præterea & simplici tegmine capitis. atque est cùm lupinâ aut tale aliquid imponit, tutela simul & signi causâ, ut ductoribus ordinum cùm strenuè aut aliter pugnaverint, possint innotescere. Telum verò quod Grosphos vocamus habet in longitudine quidem plerumque duorum cubitorum, in crassitie verò unius digiti. Ferrum est unius spithamæ, atque

page.notes: Greek column: several words are uncertain and are not marked with [?] in every case; the readings "γέσφους", "ἀσσεπικοσμεῖσαι", "ἐπιτίθεται", "κέντρον" and the line ending "ἀπίθαμιαῖον" should be checked against the scan. Italic use in the Latin column is uncertain: the first line and final word appear italic, the middle lines look roman. "Sed ARMA-tertia" is as printed. The strips at the left edge are from the neighbouring page and are excluded.
